encounters.notes: Baptistery: memories frozen in glass; only a magnetic pull shatters them.
The Nave: living lamps. Kill one and the Crush timer speeds up; spare and polish for +10 s of air.
Kneeling zealots whose hymn stuns polishers; the jelly adds Grief and refraction fog.
Library: trick-weak scribes under a chandelier of zealots.
The lector's lead barriers recolour every beam; reach ICE through an Azure pane.
Low tide: oil trails and Oil-Blight.
Porcelain ghosts quoting Zeal lore around a Mammon remnant that applies Ruin.
The elite pair at 28 Hz; sever the tubules or they feed the tendrils 1 plate per 8 s. Time Atoms on Break.
